title: A Night at the LLM Zoo: Data Conditioned Flow Matching for Generating Pretrained LLM Weights
abstract: arXiv:2611.07103v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A challenge to Weight Space Learning as it expands from task specific and vision models to Large Language Models (LLMs) is the absence of a well curated and analyzed LLM population. To address this, we train such a model zoo for application to Weight Space Generation by systematically varying the data mixture composition between web text, books, mathematics, coding, and French across populations of 51M, 124M, and 355M parameter GPT-2 Models, each tier with count N = 100. We analyze these populations by cosine similarity, functional diversity, Leave-One-Mixture-Out modeling, and variance decomposition. We show that the zoo contains diverse models whose variation is structured by training mixture composition. We embed the training mixture composition to condition a Flow Matching model of complete pretrained LLM weights in Gram-PCA compressed weight space. translated_title: LLM模型动物园之夜：用于生成预训练大语言模型权重的数据条件流匹配
translated_abstract: 随着权重空间学习从特定任务模型和视觉模型扩展到大语言模型（LLM），一个挑战在于缺乏经过精心策划和分析的LLM模型群体。为了解决这一问题，我们训练了这样一个模型动物园，应用于权重空间生成：我们在51M、124M和355M参数规模的GPT-2模型群体中，系统地改变网络文本、书籍、数学、编程和法语之间的训练数据混合组成，每个规模层级包含N=100个模型。我们通过余弦相似度、功能多样性、留一混合建模和方差分解来分析这些模型群体，结果表明该动物园包含多样化的模型，且模型间的变化由训练数据混合组成所结构化。我们将训练混合组成进行嵌入，以此条件化一个流匹配模型，从而在Gram-PCA压缩的权重空间中生成完整的预训练LLM权重。通过展示对保留混合的零样本泛化能力，并测量连续……
tldr: 本文构建了首个通过系统变化数据混合（网络文本、书籍、数学、编程、法语）训练的大规模LLM模型动物园，并提出以数据混合为条件的流匹配模型，能够在Gram-PCA压缩权重空间中直接生成完整的预训练LLM权重，且可零样本泛化到未见过的数据混合。
en_tdlr: This paper builds a curated LLM model zoo trained on systematically varied data mixtures and introduces a data-mixture-conditioned Flow Matching model that generates complete pretrained LLM weights in Gram-PCA compressed weight space, demonstrating zero-shot generalization to held-out mixtures.
